method: Published interpreter, unmodified tables, independently chosen raw inputs/event ordering and independent effect/bound oracles.

findings.title: T15 sends a new business effect after the root deadline expires while the lease is still valid
locations: Bảng Giá trị / làm thao tác
findings.oracle: Once the root deadline expires, a newly initiated business effect requires an explicit extension; an existing in-flight effect may still be reconciled.
findings.fix: Check root deadline at the send/intent authorization boundary, not only at claim. Route expiry to the existing deadline/reconciliation path; add an invariant for new sends after expiry.

findings.title: MB=1 nevertheless permits compensation send number 2 on lease expiry
locations: Bảng Giá trị / hết hạn giữ at Bù
findings.oracle: MB is declared as the compensation attempt ceiling; a new attempt may start only while the pre-increment count is below MB.
findings.fix: Authorize a new compensation attempt only when lần_bù < MB, then increment and enqueue atomically. Do not suppress reconciliation or completion of an already authorized attempt. Check every send edge, including T66/T81/T88/T90/T94.

findings.title: T88 starts a new compensation after the recovery deadline has expired
locations: Bảng Giá trị / hết hạn giữ at Bù
findings.oracle: PH is the recovery time budget. Expiry may permit recording/reconciling already initiated effects, but must not silently authorize a new compensation without Owner extension.
findings.fix: Check PH before each new recovery effect. Route to the specified Owner escalation, preserve pending evidence, and require the existing explicit extension before a new attempt. B9 must test the relevant deadline behavior, not just that a deadline flag exists.
